text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card and tool outputs (29.0% vs 3.5% expected, 23% low-complexity share, 49 charts, 0 of 24 below billed, note signal rates, 11 of 45 data without tests). The headline and cautious 'inconclusive' leaning fit the hybrid_review output, which was also undecided. Next steps are concrete and name claims. Weaknesses: the rationale repeats itself (29% vs 3.5% twice, 0 below billed twice), the headline's 'low-complexity patients' is a loose framing of 23%, and the 'share is high in every complexity band' claim is true but not tied to a number. The example claims are only 2 of the 25 low-complexity ones, and none of the 4 supported 99215 claims or flagged note examples (C0053721) are cited, so the targeted-sample next step is thin. The 'notes may be inflated' line sits awkwardly against 'moderate signals' when the tool said looks_inflated false. The 0% comparison rate is uninformative.
